notes.title: Remoteness Update 1.90 Live!
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

As we continue to work on Remoteness and listen to you, we wanted to express a genuine thank you to everyone supporting us and we hope you will enjoy our new game update.

Build v 1.90 has just been pushed, which includes many changes such as: 

- Unity engine version update (HDRP 12+)
- totally revised and improved AI (enemies are now smarter, able to use cover points, throw grenades, find close shelter points if damaged, and communicate better)
- new physically based camera depth of field
- revised and fixed ladders climbing system
- diagonal ramping added (such as short stairs)
- support for dynamic resolution (enable from main menu -> graphics settings)
- added support for TXAA
- revised game difficulty internal system
- overall performance improvement
- overall graphics improvement
+ minor fixes


KR Games team

notes.title: Remoteness build 1.80 - update
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

thanks a lot for your great support since the release of Remoteness.

We just pushed a new 1.80 build, including the following changes

- completely new ladder climbing system
- energy flow can now be ortiented also while raining
- added save points on major towers
- targets differentiation: now the minimap shows main, optional and power generators targets in 3 different colors
- fixed Hanna collision with player
- motion blur while running on/off option added in main menu
- drones are now smarter and stronger
- Chinatown computer 2 target better explained
- performance improvement
- minor fixes

KR Games team

notes.title: Steam Release Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

we wanted to share some great news with you!

First thing first: the official [b]Steam Release Gameplay Trailer[/b] for Remoteness has been uploaded on the store page; we waited as we wanted to make sure to reflect the actual gameplay as close as possible to the final release state! 🎉

[b]Beta testing[/b]: closed beta testing has completed and we started open beta, so if you are interested, please join our official Discord channel using the link on the Steam page.

[b]The release date[/b] is confirmed to be [b]September 23rd[/b] worldwide and, as you can imagine, we are really excited. We can't wait to get your feedback on the game!

As always, thanks a lot for your support, we need it! 💚🤍

KR Games team

notes.title: New release date!
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

we have a (hopefully) good news for you!

UPDATE: #Remoteness will release on Steam for PC users on Friday, September the 23rd! 🎮🎉

We decided to move the release date one week ahead of schedule as we feel it better fits the team and, of course, our future players needs!

Closed Beta testing will start really soon, so if you are interested, please join our official Discord channel using the link on the Steam page.

Thanks for your support, we need it! 💚🤍

KR Games team

notes.title: Remoteness will release on Steam on Friday, September the 30th!
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

as promised, with a little a bit of delay, but...we finally have a date!

#Remoteness will release on Steam for PC users on Friday, September the 30th! 🎮🎉

We are extremely excited for this announcement and we really can't wait to have you playing the game and get your feedback.

Further details on beta testing will come, so if you are interested, please join our official Discord channel using the link on the Steam page.

As always, many thanks for your warm support, we really appreciate it! 💚🤍

KR Games team
